name: filtered-manifold-benchmark-relevant
description: A filtered subset of a manifold benchmark focused on relevance — intended to evaluate models on relevance classification/ranking tasks. It provides query–document pairs (or similar items) filtered for relevance evaluation to measure retrieval and ranking quality. The dataset is aimed at assessing models' ability to distinguish relevant vs. non-relevant items under varied conditions.
evaluation_method: ranking metrics such as nDCG/MAP and classification metrics such as accuracy/F1
general_score_metric: nDCG@k (for ranking) / accuracy or F1 (for classification)
reputation: A small/experimental Hugging Face-hosted dataset with limited community visibility compared to established IR benchmarks.
